label: F36 water_riverdrake b5b
brief: One water creature on a neutral stage beside a 1.80 m human ruler: hit react, faint end, swimming at a water surface (two moments), and carrying the trainer on its back as a swim mount. Judge the creature's model and material as the game's real look - readability, surface, face, scale against the ruler - and whether the hit reads as a hit, the faint reads as down, the swim reads as swimming and the rider sits on its back, without clipping or floating.
defects: Hit react reads as idle or standing
Faint end does not read as down (kneeling, sitting up, upright or a belly-up flip)
Swim reads as standing or wading rather than swimming
Creature style does not match the owner creature style bar (cartoon or toy-like rather than naturalistic)
